summary: Teaches how to review and apply Adaptive Logs drop-rate recommendations, create exemptions, and segment logs.

needs.description: Log data ingested into Loki with enough query history and patterns (7-day display delay, 15-day window) for Adaptive Logs to show pattern recommendations; "Apply all recommendations" needs at least one pattern row.
needs.evidence: content.json: "Logs ingested into Grafana Cloud"; review-apply: 7 day delay before patterns shown

needs.description: Adaptive Logs (grafana-adaptivelogs-app / Adaptive Telemetry) enabled and accessible in the stack.
Log streams with a label such as namespace for segment and exemption stream selector examples.

reviewNotes: Pattern table depends on aged ingest/query history; a freshly seeded stack may show empty Patterns tab. Dossier 'Before you begin' was only a heading; content.json lists the real prerequisites.
